notes.pilot: Run with --max-batches 1 and inspect exactly five committed cases before continuation.
notes.rollout: Maximum four Agent turns. A1 may halt only when settled; A2 defaults to FINAL unless all three extension flags remain true.
notes.rubric_generation: Generate independently per eligible trajectory. No semantic consolidation or semantic merge. Deduplicate only exact public criterion content within the source case and outcome stratum.
notes.verification: Every new criterion must pass its public M/C Gate and the existing three-rerun, two-target-hit KEEP rule.
notes.cumulative_bank: Start empty. Add only newly verified KEEP criteria. Score against the full frozen cumulative bank; NA remains unscored.
notes.isolation: Fresh base adapter, empty bank, empty run cache and new output root; no prior KEEP or checkpoint inheritance.
